PROP-57888860-inv-004.text: Each commitment byte array must be exactly BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT length before deserialization.
PROP-57888860-inv-004.assertion: forall verify_batch(comms_bytes): forall c in comms_bytes: len(c) == BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT

locations.note: Calls deserialize_compressed_g1_points which validates each commitment is exactly BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT (48 bytes) before deserializing
